archive_roots.gen: ephemeral task234 self-play frames; regenerate with generation_tasks + search_play (see generation_command)

method: Read engine frames only. A counter zombie (pogo/balloon/digger/polevaulter/dolphin/football/jack/ladder/gargantuar/zamboni/snorkel) triggers when it is <=3 columns from the house, left of the rightmost plant in its lane, within 1.5 cells right of that plant, or (for bypass zombies) inside x<=400. The start is 300 ticks before the first trigger. No card or tactic is chosen.

success: all target threats gone or off board by horizon

special_not_scored.bungee: left the board is not killed; needs a no-steal criterion
